# Verified combination, Python 3.12, 2026-08-10: all 12 files in p4_proxy/tests run and pass,
# 312 tests, the only skip being the one test that declares it needs a live switch.
#
# [Co-developed with claude code -- Adam]

grpcio>=1.50.0

# Pinned, not floored, and the floor this file used to carry -- protobuf>=4.21.0 -- was not
# merely loose but wrong: p4runtime ships _pb2 modules generated by protoc 3.x, and protobuf
# 4.21+ refuses to import them ("your generated code is out of date"). No environment that has
# ever run these tests satisfied it; /home/adam/p4dev-python-venv, the interpreter they pass
# under, has 3.20.3. CI installed nothing, so the contradiction stayed invisible until CI began
# installing this file.
protobuf==3.20.3
p4runtime==1.4.1

fastapi>=0.95.0
uvicorn>=0.22.0
networkx>=3.0

# proxy_agent/kernel_notifier.py imports this. It was missing, which is what made
# test_kernel_notifier.py die on a clean interpreter.
requests>=2.28

# tests/test_topology_properties.py drives the topology graph through random link up/down
# sequences. Pinned exactly: this repo has been bitten by a typosquat that shipped under a
# widely-used name (mcp 2.0.0 vendoring a fake httpx), so nothing here floats.
hypothesis==6.165.5

# Not imported by the proxy. bmv2's counter/register CLI needs the thrift binding, and the
# recipe took two tries to get right (verified live 2026-08-13, HANDOFF section 4):
#
#   BM=/home/adam/P4_Source_Code/behavioral-model
#   PYTHONPATH="$BM/targets/simple_switch:$BM/tools" p4_proxy/venv/bin/python \
#       "$BM/targets/simple_switch/sswitch_CLI.py" --thrift-port <9090+dpid>
#   # then e.g.:  counter_read egress_port_counter <index>
#
# Two traps the obvious recipe hits: (1) the installed /usr/local/bin/simple_switch_CLI wrapper
# appends /home/adam/p4dev-python-venv's site-packages, but sswitch_CLI / runtime_CLI live only
# in the behavioral-model source tree, so it ModuleNotFounds no matter which interpreter runs
# it; point PYTHONPATH at the source dirs instead. (2) p4dev-python-venv's own thrift is a
# broken namespace ("cannot import name 'Thrift'"), which is exactly why this line pins a real
# thrift into the proxy venv -- that venv is the one interpreter with a working thrift AND, via
# PYTHONPATH, the CLI modules. No root; the CLI talks TCP to the thrift port.
thrift==0.24.0
